title: 反馈驱动的交互式改进：瓶颈在于利用而非生成
summary: 本研究通过受控的师生协议实验，分离了多轮语言智能体交互中反馈、重采样和格式修正对性能提升的影响。发现自我反馈增益有限，而外部教师反馈的有效性取决于学生利用反馈的能力，而非教师身份。建议评估反馈型智能体时应与重复尝试基线对比。
summary_en: This study disentangles the effects of feedback, resampling, and format correction in multi-turn language agent interactions via a controlled student-teacher protocol. It finds that self-generated feedback adds little beyond unguided self-refinement, while effective external feedback gains depend more on the student's ability to use feedback than on the teacher's identity. It recommends evaluating feedback-based agents against repeated-attempt baselines.
